answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 566 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pearl. The ivory index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the knoll queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. A 297 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
